tema: The Wow! signal received from space in 1977
titulo: The 72-Second Signal From Space That Never Returned
hook: In 1977, a deep-space radio signal hit Earth at thirty times louder than the background silence of space—and it was tuned to the exact frequency physicists predicted aliens would use.
descricao: In 1977, a radio telescope detected a 72-second burst from Sagittarius that matched every theoretical model of an alien broadcast. Do you think it was a message from an extraterrestrial civilization?

sem_comprovacao: This signal hit that exact frequency.

versoes.rascunho: On a quiet night in 1977, a telescope caught something impossible. What landed on that printer paper changed how we view the void forever. An astronomer named Jerry Ehman was reviewing paper printouts from an IBM computer. He was checking standard noise from deep space. Then, he saw a spike. Not random static. It was a clean, focused radio signal coming from the constellation Sagittarius. Years earlier, physicists predicted aliens would communicate using 1420 megahertz. That is the natural frequency of hydrogen, the universe's most common element. This signal hit that exact frequency. Because of Earth's rotation, the telescope could only track a target for 72 seconds. The signal climbed for 36 seconds, peaked, and faded for 36 seconds. It matched an artificial deep-space transmission perfectly. Jerry took a red pen, circled the printout code, and wrote "Wow!" The peak intensity reached thirty times louder than the silence of space. Astronomers searched those exact stars thousands of times afterward. Nothing ever repeated. Was it an alien civilization calling out just once, or a mystery we missed?
